headline: Galy cultured cocoa goes to market; FDA opens salt substitutes in standardized breads
summary: Galy is launching cell-cultured cocoa in the US (WunderHaus) and to professional kitchens, a funded cocoa-free player that is both a partnership target and a direct competitor for Belcolade.

The FDA will allow salt substitutes in 139 standardized foods, including breads and rolls, from December 14, 2026, giving bakery customers a clear path to sodium reduction and Puratos a sell-in moment.

Pressure is mounting on HHS to publish a federal ultra-processed food definition, alongside proposed GRAS reforms, so Puratos should audit US ingredient dossiers and ready clean-label options for packaged bakery customers.
Sugar and egg replacement keep moving: Oobli and Cosun built a sugar replacer for chocolate, and MOA Foodtech and Espiga are partnering on egg replacement for bakery.
Large North American bakers such as Grupo Bimbo are adding fibre and protein, and Kemin is promoting clean-label baking guides, which raises the bar for Puratos fibre and clean-label solutions.

items.title: Targeted flavour development in chocolate: omics-driven insights into cocoa fermentation
items.summary: A review of how omics tools (genomics, metabolomics) are being used to steer cocoa fermentation toward targeted chocolate flavours.
items.why: Supports Belcolade's work on controlled cocoa fermentation and starter cultures to deliver consistent origin flavour profiles.

items.title: FDA Clears Alt-Salts for More Foods, But Will Brands Reformulate?
items.summary: Coverage of the FDA rule allowing salt substitutes in more standardized foods, and whether brands will reformulate.
items.why: Opens a sodium-reduction path for standardized breads and rolls; a sell-in moment for Puratos salt-reduction solutions ahead of the December 2026 effective date.

items.title: Chocolate Makers Report Volume Growth as Cocoa Demand Finds a Floor
items.summary: StoneX market commentary reporting that chocolate makers are seeing volume growth again as cocoa demand stabilises.
items.why: A demand floor after the cocoa price shock is a cue for Belcolade to plan volumes and pricing as customers return from cocoa-saving recipes.

items.title: Why experts are pushing RFK Jr. to release a federal definition of ultraprocessed foods
items.summary: Experts are pressing HHS Secretary RFK Jr. to publish a federal definition of ultra-processed foods.
items.why: A US UPF definition would affect packaged bread, cakes and confectionery; prepare clean-label, fewer-additive reformulation options for customers.

items.title: Kemin e-book covers formulating for clean label
items.summary: Kemin released an e-book on formulating clean-label foods with ingredient swaps and technical support.
items.why: A competitor push on clean-label bakery formulation; benchmark against Puratos clean-label messaging and support.

items.title: EWG evaluation of food chemicals: Titanium dioxide
items.summary: The Environmental Working Group published an evaluation of titanium dioxide as a food additive.
items.why: Ongoing US pressure on titanium dioxide affects white icings, decorations and coated confectionery; Patisserie and Chocolate customers will want TiO2-free whiteners.

items.title: Reese’s Christmas rollout signals new confectionery playbook
items.summary: Hershey is expanding Reese's for Christmas with Advent calendars, selection boxes and festive products.
items.why: Shows seasonal and sharing formats driving confectionery growth in the US, an angle for Belcolade customers' holiday ranges.

items.title: Applications of pulse ingredients in bakery products
items.summary: A book chapter on using pulse flours, proteins and fibres in bakery products.
items.why: A practical reference for protein- and fibre-enriched bread and pulse-based gluten-free formulations in Puratos Bakery mixes.

items.title: Food For Life launches organic sprouted bagels
items.summary: Food For Life launched organic sprouted bagels under its Ezekiel 4:9 bread line.
items.why: Shows US demand for sprouted, whole-grain bakery formats; a cue for sprouted-grain and wholegrain solutions in Bakery.

items.title: WinCo Foods Hoagie Rolls Recalled For Undeclared Sesame
items.summary: WinCo Foods hoagie rolls were recalled in the US because they contained undeclared sesame.
items.why: Sesame is now a major US allergen and keeps causing bread recalls; bakery customers need tight allergen controls on shared lines and ingredients.
